text:
hadley: noticed weird p90 regressions after kernel v2.3 rolled to some H100 pools.

sam: which workloads? long-context or short-chat?

hadley: mainly long-context (seq_len >= 4096) - throughput down ~8-12% and KV cache fragmentation spiking.

mei: saw similar on staging. KV miss rate jumped from 4% -> 18% for packed batches.

jordan: logs show kernel-selector flipping between kernel_a (fast small-seq) and kernel_b (optimized-kv) for the same gpu run, leading to fragmented KV caches.

hadley: exact prof snippet:

```
kernel_selector: decision=flip count=87 window=5m
model=redwood-opus seq_len=4096 gpu=H100
kv_cache_allocs=+1.2k/sec kv_cache_frag=0.62
kernels_used=[kernel_a:54%, kernel_b:46%]
median_throughput(kernel_a)=105 tok/s
median_throughput(kernel_b)=98 tok/s
```

sam: hmm. kernel_b shouldn't be selected so often for 4k sequences on H100; we should bias toward kernel_a sticky for mixed batches.

rachel: any config we can tweak quickly? might need rollback if customer SLAs hit.

hadley: proposal draft: 
- enforce per-gpu token-budget targets instead of single global cap
- sticky kernel selection for N minutes when kv_frag > 0.5
- two lanes in queue: low-latency (pack small seqs aggressively) + high-throughput (allow large-token batches up to max_tokens)

config snippet:

```
batch_policy:
  max_sequences: "T4:24,L4:32,A10:40,A100:64,H100:96"
  max_tokens: "T4:4096,L4:6144,A10:8192,A100:16384,H100:24576"
  kv_frag_threshold: "0.6"
  kernel_stick_seconds: "180"
  queue_lanes: "latency,throughput"
```

jordan: numbers look reasonable. We should canary on H100 and A100 pools with kernel v2.3 + sticky-selector patch.

mei: also add adaptive max_tokens: reduce max_tokens by 25% if kv_frag > 0.7 to avoid extreme fragmentation.

sam: metrics to watch: p50/p90 latency, kv_miss_rate, kernel_switch_rate, throughput tok/s, batch_fill_ratio.

rachel: set alert if p90 latency on production higher than baseline by 15% for 10m.

ops-bot: deploy_canary started by @jordan -> canary-id=canary-33123 status=running :rocket: 

hadley: next steps: run 2x 2-hour loadtests per GPU type (T4,L4,A10,A100,H100) with mixed workload (70% short <128, 20% mid <1024, 10% long >=4096).

jordan: i'll own the canary + perf dashboard. plan to ship sticky selector + per-gpu budgets.

mei: i'll prepare evals and eviction traces.

sam: tagging infra and oncall. @oncall please be ready to rollback.

rachel: thanks, folks. keep posts here with short updates.

hadley: :thumbsup:
